correctness.rationale: The source reserve tests were translated to exact floor counts; the middle-level count is uniformly bounded. Strict convexity c'' > 0 and a two-segment convex envelope give the optimal continuous payload with O(1) uniform rounding. Fractional-linear comparison proves the unique maximal normalized budget and Jensen proves uniform middle precision is the unique finite-rank optimum at that budget. A packaged independent implementation of the source reserve test passed 17,723 exact-rational checks, including exhaustive count optimizations for ranks 1 through 12 and the rank-64 witness. The general assertion is analytically proved, not extrapolated from enumeration.

value.rationale: The source studies the same singular-value certificate optimization but previously quantifies greedy inefficiency only in finite experiments. A complete analytic three-tier frontier identifies which tolerance is maximally expensive and gives a practical stringent-budget witness: (8,12,32), rank 64, 1676 versus 768 payload at 3.13% norm certificate. The family proves increasingly high reserve precision can systematically worsen local payload despite feasible uniform medium precision. This is substantive guidance for approximation guarantees and candidate safeguards, while remaining limited to certified factor-bit payload.
